reflections.self_assessment: As the Assassin, I had difficulty in guessing the correct target despite completing all missions successfully. I should have paid more attention to Diana's behavior and avoided guessing the good player Bob.

player_observations.Bob: Bob played a very safe game and was completely inconspicuous, it was hard to distinguish him from other good players. He might benefit from taking more risks and influencing the game more.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's actions seemed random and he didn't have a clear strategy, it's possible he was trying to confuse the group but was unsuccessful in his goals.
player_observations.Diana: As the Merlin, Diana excelled in leading the team to success and completing missions, her leadership skills were impressive. She managed to keep her true role hidden throughout the game, which is a difficult task for the Merlin.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was very active in the game and took bold moves, her assertiveness was beneficial to the good team's success. However, she might benefit from being more cautious and not revealing her role so easily in future games.

reflections.self_assessment: I was too cautious and failed to make impactful moves, ultimately resulting in failure for my missions. I could improve by being more decisive and trusting my instincts, even when the situation seems uncertain.

player_observations.Diana: Diana played a stealthy game, often going unnoticed until it was too late, where she would make her moves and gain the upper hand. Her ability to fly under the radar was impressive.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was a reliable ally, consistently executing his missions with precision and care. He seems to understand the game dynamics well and plays to his strengths.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's role as the Assassin was well-suited to her playstyle, which was aggressive and opportunistic. She would often take risks that paid off, keeping the team on their toes.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's strategic prowess and cunning nature made him an excellent Merlin, guiding the team towards success. His ability to read the game state and make informed decisions was impressive.

reflections.self_assessment: I maintained secrecy throughout and was instrumental in the success of both missions 2 and 3. One area for improvement is to further communicate with our merlin (who was Diana) to provide support in identifying the killer. I could have also provided more convincing alibis to make it harder for Charlie to determine our good players.

player_observations.Alice: Her playstyle was initially cautious and strategic but eventually revealed as a sneaky killer when she was revealed as the assassin. This was a surprise since I thought she would play more on the safe side.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie's playstyle was quite aggressive, as seen from his early attempts to identify the assassin in the assassin phase. His actions led to a false accusation which helped me stay safe.
player_observations.Diana: Diana was extremely skilled in remaining hidden throughout the game, keeping her Merlin identity concealed until the end. She did an excellent job of supporting our team without exposing her true role.
player_observations.Eve: Eve's playstyle was balanced and cautious, contributing effectively to both missions. She also helped distract Charlie, providing us a window to work freely.

reflections.self_assessment: I played well by effectively identifying and supporting my teammates as a leader and member, but I could have been more cautious and discerning with the team compositions to prevent failures.

player_observations.Diana: She successfully manipulated the team compositions to maximize the evil side's chances of winning, demonstrating strategic decision-making.
player_observations.Eve: Her playstyle seemed focused on deception, trying to fit in with the team while secretly working against us, but I didn't quite realize her role until the game ended.
player_observations.Alice: Alice was surprisingly unobtrusive and didn't display any distinct patterns, making her difficult to distinguish from other good players, which indicates she is a strong player in an undercover role.
player_observations.Charlie: He played extremely well as Merlin, consistently providing support and guidance to the good players without being discovered, revealing his incredible role-specific skills.

reflections.self_assessment: I failed to convince anyone that I was the Merlin, and my actions were too predictable as an Evil character, which ultimately led to my exposure and downfall. I should have created more confusion and deceit, and played more aggressively to disguise my true intentions.

player_observations.Eve: Eve played a solid good-aligned role without getting targeted, indicating strong discretion and ability to fit in with the group.
player_observations.Bob: Bob, being an oblivious good, fit perfectly into the group's dynamic and didn't suspect anyone, showcasing his trust and teamwork skills.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's successful Merlin runs demonstrated her exceptional strategic thinking, ability to make sound judgments, and influence over the group's decision-making.
player_observations.Alice: As the Assassin, Alice played an extremely stealthy and cautious role, avoiding suspicion until the very end, which was impressive and caught us all off guard.

reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, I was initially successful but ultimately underutilized my abilities, failing to effectively support my allies and protect key information. I struggled to balance revealing information to the right players and keeping secrets from the traitors. A more strategic approach to information sharing and mission planning could have improved my chances of winning.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played cautiously, but effectively as a loyal member. She kept information to herself until necessary and contributed positively to team decisions.
player_observations.Bob: Bob was highly effective as a loyal leader, using his authority to guide the team towards mission success. He maintained trust and kept his cards hidden well.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's actions as a traitor were subtle but impactful. She cleverly hid her intentions until the final missions, using her position to manipulate the outcome in the favor of the evil team.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played both sides very well, using her double role as a loyal member and a spy to get information and influence key decision-making. She was successful in staying under the radar but ultimately betrayed the team in a way that contributed to their downfall.

reflections.self_assessment: Unable to reflect on this game.

I navigated the missions effectively, making strategic choices to influence or mislead the opposing team. I concealed my role well, but could have provided more subtle hints to further disrupt the good team's dynamics.

player_observations.Alice: Alice relied heavily on Bob for guidance, revealing a possible trust dynamic; she also seemed overly cautious in some situations.
player_observations.Bob: Bob took calculated risks and led missions successfully, but sometimes overestimated his team's capacity, allowing the opposing team to capitalize.
player_observations.Charlie: Despite the pressure, Merlin remained composed and insightful, but at times seemed uncertain about his actions and their impact.
player_observations.Eve: The Assassin played stealthily, but a careless mistake during the fourth mission exposed her intentions, which could have been avoided with more caution.

reflections.self_assessment: I managed to maintain a low-risk strategy while still contributing to my team's victories, but I could improve by taking more calculated risks and actively trying to eliminate the assassin.

player_observations.Alice: Alice's aggressive approach as the assassin led to her being discovered, but it's worth noting that she played well under the pressure of being suspected.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's inconsistent voting pattern made it difficult for me to accurately assess his alignment, but ultimately, he proved to be a loyal member of the good team.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played quietly but effectively as the evil traitor, using her position to gather information without drawing much attention to herself.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's exceptional leadership skills were apparent throughout the game, and her ability to coordinate missions while maintaining her identity as the merlin was impressive.

reflections.self_assessment: As the Assassin, I performed well, adapting to the various team compositions and successfully eliminating targets without being caught. I could improve by being more cautious during Mission 2 to avoid the Merlin's intervention. Overall, my survival rate and killing efficiency were high.

player_observations.Alice: Alice was extremely cautious and transparent, often being upfront about her good role, which didn't pose a significant threat to my existence.
player_observations.Bob: Bob seemed to be too focused on winning for the good team, frequently putting himself in danger and making his allegiance known, which was not very subtle.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played a masterful game as the Merlin, skillfully manipulating and protecting his team members while making himself appear as the target, keeping the Assassin's focus on him.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played a solid game, keeping a relatively low profile and only making calculated moves, which wasn't enough to tip off my suspicions about her evil role.
